name: Mississippi
status_why: The results frame answered 503 to a script and in a browser on 2026-10-09; recheck once in the week before Nov 3.
system: State-built: the Secretary of State's election results pages (www.sos.ms.gov/elections-voting/election-results/<year>/<slug>), each showing an ASPX results page in a frame from sos.ms.gov/elections/electionresults_aspx/; the official results are posted later as PDF recapitulations.

results_page.label: Mississippi Secretary of State: results
results_page.source: answered one request with the kit's User-Agent (N4, 2026-10-10)

election.how_to_find: Recheck the frame host once in late October.

feeds.updates: Unofficial figures are typed in as circuit clerks report; frequency not stated.
feeds.note: On 2026-10-09 the frame host sos.ms.gov/elections/electionresults_aspx/elections_results_2024_general.aspx answered 503 with an Akamai 'errors.edgesuite.net' error page to a script AND in the Browser pane, so it may be retired or down rather than walled. The listing page www.sos.ms.gov/elections-voting/election-results answered scripts 200 (185 KB; links to every election back to 2003).

feeds.address: Same pages; certified totals later as PDFs (the 2026 primaries: www.sos.ms.gov/content/documents/elections/2026/Recap%20report%20Democratic%20Primary%202026.pdf and .../republican%20primary%202026.pdf)
feeds.note: The PDFs are what ms.py reads.

races_in_feed: Statewide feed: federal, statewide, judicial, legislative specials. County and municipal races are reported by circuit and municipal clerks; Mississippi's county offices were elected in 2023, so Nov 3 2026 is mainly Senate, House, judges and specials.
local: Some circuit clerks post their own returns (Hinds, Harrison, DeSoto, Rankin); addresses not checked today.
how_counted: Circuit clerks report to the Secretary of State; the certified recapitulations follow.
count_order: Absentee ballots are counted at the precincts in most counties.
vote_types: No split by ballot type in the state pages (absentee ballots are counted at the precincts in most counties).

certify.rule: Within 30 days after the election (Miss. Code 23-15-605); state officers are canvassed by the Legislature.
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_blocked: sos.ms.gov (the frame host, without www) returned an Akamai error 503 to a script and to the Browser pane on 2026-10-09. www.sos.ms.gov answered scripts.
scout_plan: Mississippi has no machine-readable election-night feed that answered today. Recheck the frame host in the week before Nov 3 (one request); if it answers, read its HTML tables every 10 minutes for the Senate, the four House seats and the judicial races, labelled unofficial. If it still fails, Election Night shows Mississippi as a link out to the Secretary's results page (no figures) and fills in the certified recapitulation PDFs when they post. No local level beyond what those pages carry.
notes: Runoff rules for any special election to be confirmed by the phase 3 reader.
